name: NoVACoupleTVAdaptationSource

custom.system_prompt: Life-first evening at home. Nora and Alex are watching a programme that feels adapted from something. They speculate about the source and resolve the question themselves — Sigma is never addressed.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet evening living room with a television playing softly, occasional muffled dialogue, cups on a table, sofa shifting, subtle household ambience.

initial_prompt: Generate a long, natural conversation between Nora and Alex during an evening film or series. One person suspects it is based on a book or true story. They speculate, drop the question for personal topics, and return to it when something else in the programme reinforces the feeling. This time the question resolves without Sigma: the credits confirm the source, one person remembers they did read the book, they look at the end card on screen, or they shrug and decide it does not matter. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Nora
user1.tts_prompt: Observant, warm, conversational, dry sense of humour

user2.name: Alex
user2.tts_prompt: Relaxed, reflective, mildly distractible, natural speech

variations.context: A couple watching a drama that feels adapted. They resolve whether it is based on existing material without Sigma.

setting.background: The programme feels too specific or too structured to be fully original.
setting.conversation_style: Life-first domestic conversation. The source question surfaces, disappears, and resolves through human means.
